AIIMS Jodhpur Project Technical Support III Recruitment 2026 - Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Jodhpur Project Technical Support III Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for All India Institute of Medical Sciences Jodhpur (AIIMS Jodhpur), a prestigious government organization located in Jodhpur, Rajasthan.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Project Technical Support-III (MSW). This position is offered on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Technical Support-III (MSW) post in this AIIMS Jodhpur recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview directly on the specified date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the walk-in interview date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Project Technical Support-III (MSW) post is scheduled for 24 August 2026. Candidates must report on time.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a PG in sociology or social work. Desirable qualifications include experience in community-based projects and proficiency in Hindi, English, and local language.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for this post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Project Technical Support-III (MSW) post is 35 years as of the interview date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for Project Technical Support-III (MSW)?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Technical Support-III (MSW) post will receive a salary of ₹ 28000 per month plus HRA as admissible.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment. Candidates can apply for free.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the "Important Links" section of this article or by visiting the official website of AIIMS Jodhpur.
